Name: Load-Use Pipeline Stall
objective: Explain why a dependent ALU instruction must wait one cycle for a load result in the illustrated pipeline.
learning_objective: Explain why a dependent ALU instruction must wait one cycle for a load result in the illustrated pipeline.
core_conclusion: When load data arrives too late for the next EX stage, hold the consumer and front end, let the load advance, and resume with the returned data.

terminology.scope: Illustrative five-stage pipeline with forwarding, one-cycle memory, load data available at end of MEM and dependent operand needed at start of EX. One stall follows from these assumptions, not from the ISA alone.

scenes.initial_state: Load in EX computes address; ADD in ID needs x5 next cycle.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Cycle3 has LW EX, ADD ID, younger IF.
scenes.trigger: Load-use hazard blocks the next ID→EX transfer.
scenes.change: At clock boundary advance LW to MEM; keep ADD in ID and younger instruction in IF; retain PC0x108; insert empty EX bubble with all write enables0.
scenes.cause: Load-use hazard blocks the next ID→EX transfer.
scenes.result: Older load progresses while front-end positions and PC remain identical for one extra cycle.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Load has reached memory, ADD remains held.
scenes.trigger: Memory read returns at the end of the stalled cycle.
scenes.change: Copy42 out of selected memory word into load result latch; keep memory unchanged; mark the carrying bundle rd5,42.
scenes.cause: Memory read returns at the end of the stalled cycle.
scenes.result: 42 is now available to feed the consumer next cycle.
english_copy: Now the value can be forwarded.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.initial_state: Ready load data42 in MEM/WB; ADD still in ID just before release.
scenes.trigger: Hazard clears and next clock advances the held instruction.
scenes.change: Move ADD into EX, move bubble into MEM, advance front end; send42 to ADD operand and compute42+3=45.
scenes.cause: Hazard clears and next clock advances the held instruction.
scenes.result: The consumer produces45 after exactly one held cycle, never 0+3 or address+3.

scenes.timing_reason: Mechanism motion followed by at least two seconds to inspect the settled numerical state.
scenes.change: Write42 to x5 and45 to x6 while a compact stage timeline retains the repeated ID cell and bubble cell.
scenes.result: Register result45 and the explicit extra cycle explain the stall cost.

critical_processes.uncertainty: Load address must not be treated as loaded value.
critical_processes.expected_observation: 42 arrives from memory only at end of MEM.

critical_processes.uncertainty: Consumer resumes only with actual data and bubble stays non-writing.
critical_processes.expected_observation: ADD enters EX with42,3 and yields45; bubble advances without a register write.

prompt:
A 31-second silent English educational animation for a university digital electronics course on Load-Use Pipeline Stall: distinguish load address 0x3000 from unavailable load data 42 in an illustrative five-stage pipeline with one-cycle memory; advance the load from EX to MEM while holding the consumer in ID, the next instruction in IF, and PC=0x108, and insert a non-writing EX bubble; place returned 42 into MEM/WB, resume the consumer and PC=0x10C, forward 42 into its operand, compute 42+3=45, and compare the one-cycle hold with final x5=42 and x6=45.

Use a radial dark background from #142238 through #0d1626 to #070b12 with a 72px grid and a #60a5fa glow; primary #60a5fa marks main fields, registers, or paths, accent #fbbf24 marks carried values and selected quantities, result #34d399 marks completed values or valid selections, and warn #f87171 marks discarded or unavailable work; use Helvetica Neue with Helvetica, Arial, Segoe UI, and sans-serif fallbacks, 50px headings at weight 700, 30px body copy, and 21px uppercase kickers with 5px tracking; at 30 fps, slide-up headings 22px over 16 frames from frame 8 and stagger-in copy from frame 20 in 11-frame steps with 12-frame fades and 16px rises; marker-travel carries memory response and forwarded data; hold the front-end cells while the load advances at frame 270, fill MEM/WB at 510, resume stages at 660, and reveal operand 42 and result 45 at 690 and 720; provide the Remotion source and course kit with Remotion 4.0.410, React 19.0.0, TypeScript 5.8.2, Node.js, a Chromium render environment, and FFmpeg, with 1920x1080 H264 MP4 output and no audio; exact reproduction on a clean machine has not been verified.
